The effects of an organo-mercury compound on mitosis were investigated in a cell culture of
human white blood cells. The cells were exposed to different concentrations of the compound
Observations of the chromosomes in these cells were made using a light microscope at
⋅ 400 magnification. Two types of abnormal mitosis were seen.
Type 1 the chromosomes were clumped close together in the middle of the cell.
Type 2 the spindle had not formed in the cell.
The frequency of each type of abnormality was obtained by observing 100 cells.
